title: Vibe coding a deckbuilder where you craft your cards instead of looting them (1000+ possible cards)
author: Arkenge
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I'm a solo dev vibe coding a deckbuilding roguelite called The Unwritten, in the evenings from home. Demo planned in the next few months.

The core idea: you don't loot random cards. You collect resources during fights, then fuse them into new cards, and fuse those again to evolve them. Stone + wood = stone axe, stone axe + antlers = antler axe. There are already 1000+ possible cards.

How AI fits in:

\- The game is vibe coded in GameMaker with Claude and Claude Code.

\- My devlog videos go through a pipeline I built with Claude Code: transcription, editing, subtitles, upload to YouTube.

\- This teaser was put together by Claude from my game assets and gameplay footage.



Honestly, without AI there's no way a solo dev could aim for this many cards.

Happy to answer questions about the workflow, and I'd love your thoughts on the game idea.

(Discord link in the comments if you want to follow the development)

replies.author: Arkenge
replies.body: Yes I know ! But this one turn your single attack into an AoE as the antlers allow you to hit the nearby creatures. I know it is a bit weird, but I thought it would be a fun way to upgrade the axe.
